content.comment_body: It's not really an issue, just a bit unusual. On a running [article_no] device with [product_name] operator panel, I observed a small 'x' flashing in the upper right corner of the display. The device has been operating flawlessly for several weeks. After reloading the program, the flashing 'x' disappeared. Can anyone explain what this might mean?

I've noticed the same thing. It only happens when navigating away from the message texts using the cursor down, and then returning to the start screen showing the date and time. The 'x' appears and stays visible, but the blinking frequency changes.
The [product_name] operator panel was working correctly and then suddenly this flashing 'x' appeared. Definitely odd behavior.
Perhaps this 'x' is a leftover from the development phase, acting as a basic indicator to show communication activity.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have observed a flashing 'x' on the display of a running device with an operator panel, which does not affect performance but raises curiosity. The indicator seems to appear after specific navigation actions and disappears after reloading the program. Users speculate it may signal ongoing communication or be a remnant from development, noting a lack of official documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want clear and documented explanations for display symbols and status icons to ensure system reliability and understand the purpose of these indicators.
